title: Democratic inputs to AI
snippet: Our nonprofit organization, OpenAI, Inc., is launching a program to award ten $100,000 grants to fund experiments in setting up a democratic process for deciding what rules AI systems should follow, within the bounds defined by the law.

title: Governance of superintelligence
snippet: Now is a good time to start thinking about the governance of superintelligence—future AI systems dramatically more capable than even AGI.

title: Introducing the ChatGPT app for iOS
snippet: The ChatGPT app syncs your conversations, supports voice input, and brings our latest model improvements to your fingertips.

title: Language models can explain neurons in language models
snippet: We use GPT-4 to automatically write explanations for the behavior of neurons in large language models and to score those explanations. We release a dataset of these (imperfect) explanations and scores for every neuron in GPT-2.
